summary_en: This phase 1 study tests pomalidomide given after CD19-directed CAR T-cell therapy in patients with relapsed or refractory CD19+ B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia or B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Pomalidomide is taken by mouth once a day for 10 doses, as long as the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba la pomalidomida administrada después de la terapia con células CAR T dirigidas a CD19 en pacientes con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B o linfoma no Hodgkin de células B, CD19+, recidivantes o refractarios. La pomalidomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día, durante 10 dosis, siempre que la enfermedad no progrese y la toxicidad no sea inaceptable. El registro no indica el resultado principal del estudio; se trata de un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with relapsed or refractory CD19+ B-cell leukemia or lymphoma
Received an approved commercial CD19 CAR T-cell product
Enrolled 28 to 56 days after CAR T-cell infusion
Able to swallow pills or tablets
Karnofsky performance score of at least 50%
not_for: Active grade 2 or higher graft versus host disease, cytokine release syndrome, or neurotoxicity
Stem cell transplant or rescue after the most recent CD19 CAR T-cell therapy
Pregnancy, or HIV positive by PCR within 8 weeks of screening
